Here are the descriptions of the scientific line plots, following your guidelines:

Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps," which has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis for both plots is labeled "Training Rewards" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The top plot illustrates the relationship between steps and training rewards for the easy training set. A blue solid line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," starts at approximately 0 at a step value of 0 and oscillates between 0.04 and 0.16, ending at approximately 0.08 at a step value of 500. A red solid line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," starts at approximately 0.15 at a step value of 0 and exhibits oscillations, decreasing to approximately 0.09 at a step value of 500.

The bottom plot illustrates the relationship between steps and training rewards for the hard training set. A blue solid line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard," starts at approximately 0 at a step value of 0 and generally increases, with some fluctuations, reaching approximately 0.14 at a step value of 500. A red solid line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," begins at approximately 0.08 at a step value of 0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.21 at a step value of 200, and subsequently decreases to approximately 0.06 at a step value of 500.
